as_told.title: Prince Hans-Adam convened the Roswell witnesses

plain: Hans-Adam II, the reigning prince of the small European country of Liechtenstein, is said to have gathered together all of the witnesses to the 1947 Roswell crash in New Mexico. Michels tells this himself, once crediting it to John Brandenburg, a scientist he interviewed. In a later episode he links it to the writer Whitley Strieber instead and gives no time. If true, a European head of state would have taken a private hand in the Roswell story.
